name: 🥗 Buffalo Chicken & White Bean Salad
tagline: Spicy, creamy, crunchy: buffalo chicken and white beans tossed with ranch and veggies.

steps.text: Stir the Frank's into the melted butter. Toss with the chicken.
Add the beans, celery and carrots and stir.
Fold in the dressing and season with pepper.
For lunches: pack the chicken-bean mix in one container and lettuce in another; combine at school.

kid_jobs.job: Slice the celery and carrots (with a grown-up)

chef_tip: Melted butter in the Frank's is the classic wing-sauce trick: it rounds the heat so kids can handle it.
make_ahead: The mix keeps 3 days in the fridge; it's better on day 2.
leftovers: Stuff into a wrap or pita.
swaps: Greek yogurt for half the ranch
